note: Scores are READINGS, never records. Each is a model's argument from a Wikipedia plot section alone. No edges are emitted here. No pageview or popularity number is written into this file. Not merged into corpus.json.

scale.note: anchors sit at 10 and 90 and are reference points, not ceilings

dread.measures: How much of the running time is spent expecting harm.

cruelty.measures: How the film treats the people in it — whether harm is deliberate, dwelt on, and shared by the film's own gaze.

irony.measures: The distance between what the film shows and what it means — whether the film stands behind its own images.

ambiguity.measures: How much the film refuses to settle — what is still unknowable when it ends.

fracture.measures: How far the telling departs from a single forward order — displacement, permutation, and whether any order can be recovered at all.

axisConfidenceFormulation: grounded-fraction (axes the text grounded / 5) — chosen against the GATE 5 table, not by taste
